verdict.rationale: Adyen's Agentic Feed API syncs merchant product catalogs to AI platforms such as OpenAI and Meta, so agents on those platforms can find products to buy (docs-13, docs-19, docs-20, docs-1). That makes catalog items discoverable, but Adyen publishes no directory or discovery index of payable services or APIs of its own. Discovery depends on third-party platforms, and the llms.txt probe is only a documentation index. Missing for 10: an Adyen-published directory or discovery index of payable services/APIs, a machine-readable discovery endpoint (e.g. a .well-known manifest; OpenAPI probe paths returned 404), and independent corroboration that agents can discover services this way.
